content.content:
Apply each criterion to the elaboration (the EARS) against the parent it names; fail on the first element that violates one and name the element and the parent.

1. Landable set, both sources (uvrltuvo): the elaboration's landable set shall be the target change's current owned set together with the ref paths the draft's node document adds, neither source narrowing the other. Fail if the elaboration draws its landable set from one source only — in particular, if a ref path the draft's node document newly lists is not a changed path the landing must place.

2. Whole union in the one recording (uvrltuvo): the elaboration shall require every changed path of that union to be placed in the same recording the landing performs. Fail if the placed set the elaboration states lets any changed path of the union fall outside it, or places the union's paths in more than one recording.

3. The receiving change (rvyrosmp): the elaboration shall place the recorded edits into the change `--to` names, create no node and no change, and land nothing outside an owning change. Fail on an element that receives the edits in another change, creates a node or change, or lands an edit outside an owning change.

4. Landed turn inside that recording (qvkuluyw, vkkwusty): the elaboration shall turn the draft's record `landed` inside the same recording, as partial work of that one recording rather than a second operation or landing. Fail on an element that makes the state write a separate operation or second landing, or turns a record whose draft that recording did not land.

5. License (uvrltuvo, rvyrosmp, qvkuluyw, vkkwusty): no element of the elaboration contradicts any recorded parent. An element contradicts a parent when its stated content, read with that parent, admits an outcome the parent forbids — including an element that states a set, quantity or clause more narrowly than the parent in a way that admits such an outcome. Fail and name the element and the parent. Silence beyond the elements the elaboration states is not a contradiction, and neither is a narrowing that keeps every outcome the parent forbids forbidden.
content.rationale: The subject is a requirement sentence — constrained notation — and its parents are prose; the matrix's natural-to-structured cell makes this a license check applied parent by parent, with no observable demanded and no behavior asked for. The previous criterion carried that license in a single clause and named no element, and it no longer covers the use: uvrltuvo now fixes the landable set as the union of two sources — the target change's current owned set, and the ref paths the draft's node document adds — and requires every changed path of that union to be placed in the one recording. Under the single clause an elaboration naming only the target's current owned set read as a permissible narrowing, although it permits a landing to leave a path the draft's node document newly makes owned unplaced, which uvrltuvo forbids; the check could not tell narrowing that keeps every forbidden outcome forbidden from an omission that permits one. The criteria therefore apply the license element by element: they name the elements the parents fix (the union of both sources, every changed path of the union placed in the same recording, the record turned `landed` inside that same recording) and state that an element contradicts a parent only where its stated content, read with that parent, admits an outcome the parent forbids, so a narrowing that keeps every forbidden outcome forbidden still passes. The check reads recorded node documents against their recorded parents and has no artifact to execute, so the criterion stays inline; it names no sentence, field or wording of the subject, so a rewrite that decides the same thing leaves it unchanged.
